desc: TruGlo's all-steel front and rear sight tool easily removes and installs front sights that fits Glock and Walther. It features TruGlo's Fortress finish. It contains front and rear sight installation tools for Glock pistols. Can be used to remove, install, or adjust factory or aftermarket sights. This kit is approved for use with tritium night sights and is compatible with suppressor height sights.
